benefits_health_001.answer: yes. Plan: Health Service System, City and County of San Francisco. Eligible group: unit members.
benefits_health_001.evidence: health plans available through the Health Service System, City and County of San Francisco.

benefits_health_contribution_002.answer: District assumes increased employer costs per City Charter rates. For dependents: up to $210/mo (2010-11) to $223.72/mo (2011-12) for employee plus one dependent; up to $260/mo to $273.72/mo for family coverage.
benefits_health_contribution_002.evidence: Effective July 1, 2010, the District shall make the following monthly one-twelfth [1/12] annual contributions for eligible unit members who have dependents enrolled for medical insurance coverage: up to $210/month for employee plus one dependent; up to $260/month for family coverage.

benefits_dependent_health_004.answer: yes. Categories: dependent, employee plus one dependent, family coverage. Contribution rules: District contributes up to $210/mo ($223.72 in 2011-12) for employee plus one dependent, and $260/mo ($273.72 in 2011-12) for family coverage.
benefits_dependent_health_004.evidence: Health Insurance – Dependent Medical Coverage: ... up to $210/month for employee plus one dependent; up to $260/month for family coverage.
